purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Dinghai District

queries.query: Dinghai District Zhoushan official cadastral parcel map real estate registration GIS natural resources
queries.result: Found official Zhoushan Natural Resources and Planning Bureau material covering Dinghai real-estate registration, online service, cadastral-map access, and the registration-center custodian; no anonymous parcel geometry API was verified.

queries.query: 定海区 不动产登记 地籍图 宗地图 自然资源 官方
queries.result: Found official Zhoushan notices stating that Dinghai is within the online registration scope and that rights holders may view/download cadastral parcel maps through Zhejiang government-service channels; the public pages do not expose an anonymous parcel feature response.

registryEvidence.basis: Official Zhoushan Natural Resources and Planning Bureau material states that Dinghai District is covered by the city real-estate registration workflow; the official city registration-center page assigns natural-resource cadastral and real-estate cadastral survey, results application, and registration-information query duties; the official 2024 budget identifies the Zhoushan Dinghai Real Estate Registration Center.

officialSources.observation: Official city bureau notice says that from 2023-04-01 Dinghai and Putuo are within the online real-estate registration scope, and that cadastral parcel and unit maps can be viewed/downloaded through the Zhejiang service channels by eligible rights holders.

Official city government page assigns the Zhoushan Real Estate Registration Center natural-resource and real-estate cadastral survey, cadastral-results application, registration-information query, and certificate-management duties.

Official 2024 budget identifies the Zhoushan Dinghai Real Estate Registration Center and its registration-management project; the stated objective includes maintaining 1:500 and 1:2000 base databases for declassified/desensitized social sharing.

Official city implementation opinion describes a citywide integrated natural-resources and real-estate registration database and an online full-chain land-management workflow, but publishes no open parcel feature endpoint.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Dinghai District under the Zhoushan municipal natural-resources and real-estate registration system.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official procedure and custodian evidence only; no anonymous city-bounded parcel feature response, schema, CRS, native identity, or safe polygon sample was retrieved.

remainingUncertainty: The official notice indicates cadastral-map downloads through authenticated or rights-holder-oriented Zhejiang service channels. The public first-party pages inspected do not expose a safe anonymous parcel API. A local curl attempt to the official pages timed out on DNS resolution in this environment; this does not establish service or parcel absence. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, TLS-verification disablement, or unsafe owner/address/contact/titleholder/personal/tax/account fields were used.
